original_record.title: Start of the Transcontinental Railway Exploring Party, 1901
original_record.description: The first 'flying' survey for the Transcontinental (later Trans-Australian) Railway in 1901, Kalgoorlie to Eucla. The party consisted of John Muir, C.H. Babington, W.A. Henderson, R.J. Anketell, H. Kent, J.J. Gillio, S. Flinn and an Aboriginal man named Joe, plus 16 camels.
